label: Becky under way on the Thames
caption: Colour photograph of Becky under way on a wooded reach of the Thames, seen from the bow quarter: dark hull with red rubbing strakes, cream superstructure with arched windows, name 'Becky' on the bow, and the mahogany wheelhouse aft.
